tool_call_format: <tools> block in the system turn; calls as <tool_call><function=NAME><parameter=KEY>VALUE</parameter></function></tool_call>; results as <tool_response> inside a user turn
known_template_errors: UndefinedError: 'dict object' has no attribute 'name' (tool call without a function name; raised by jinja2, not by the template)
notes: The template never reads reasoning_effort, reasoning_strength, reasoning.effort or thinking.effort: all six effort values render byte-identical output, so the variable is silently ignored rather than accepted. b11960 therefore reports no reasoning_effort_levels for this model and no effort value can produce the 500. Thinking is toggled only by enable_thinking, and only in the generation prompt: false emits a closed empty  thinking block. A developer message is accepted as the first message and merged with a following system/developer message, but any system or developer message later in the conversation is silently dropped (no error), unlike qwen3.8. Tool call arguments passed as a JSON string are silently dropped, producing an empty <function=NAME></function> block; there is no arguments check in this template. A tool call with no function name dies on an undefined name instead of a readable error.
